notes:
Account: NimbusHelp (mid-market B2B SaaS supporting e-comm & marketplaces). Primary contact: Lina Gomez (Head of CX). Use-case: automated ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging to power Zendesk macros and Freshdesk workflows; integrate with agent UI for quick replies and tool-calling (order lookup, refund flow).

Discovery summary:
- 2026-01-12 discovery call (Lina + Eng lead + AE Evelyn). Discussed current pain: long agent handle times (AHT), noisy tags, duplicate tagging across queues.
- Wants short, actionable summary (1-2 lines) at top of ticket and 3 suggested tags with confidence score.
- Integrations: Zendesk (primary), Freshdesk on smaller BUs. Need Zendesk private app and webhook support for macro triggers.
- Surge reliability requirement: peak 1,200 tickets/min during promos. Expected baseline ~120 tickets/min.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Latency target: summary snippet generation < 350ms p95 or fall back to precomputed summary cache.
- Tagging accuracy: target precision >= 85% for top tag, recall > 70% across tag set.
- Must preserve PII controls: redact payment tokens before sending to model.
- Data residency: EU customers' tickets must stay in-region (policy later).
- Auth & audit: SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS for keys.

POC scope (agreed):
- 3-week POC: run on 30k anonymized historical tickets + 1-week live shadow on staging Zendesk queue.
- Deliverables: latency report, tagging confusion matrix, suggested macro mapping, failure/fallback plan for spikes.
- Success criteria: p95 latency <350ms (or documented fallback), tagging precision >=85%, agent satisfaction delta +15% (survey).

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-01-12: Kickoff call. Action: Nimbus to share sample dataset (30k rows).
- 2026-01-19: Received redacted dataset (S3 link). Noted many multi-threaded email chains.

Integration notes / implementation details:
- Zendesk app: need private app -> app manifest approval; plan to deploy Redwood-powered summary as a right-rail app with contextual function calling for order_lookup and refund_suggestion macros.
- Freshdesk: webhook to call Redwood endpoint for batch nightly summarization + real-time for VIP queue.
- Fallbacks: smaller quantized model in Dedicated pool for lower cost; automatic downgrade to cached summary when token budget exceeded.
- Observability: request per-route token-level cost breakdown, trace ids included in ticket comment to tie to Redwood logs.

Commercial / procurement:
